text:
maria: Postmortem follow-up: new KV-churn incident today. We should land a compact playbook (one-page) with exact commands, a test harness, and explicit owners. Quick sync here.

kevin: I can draft the one-pager. Plan: 1) detect, 2) contain, 3) recover + notify. Will include exact CLI snippets.

sam: I'll attach the PromQL and a short note about request-prefix skew increasing KV keys. Also will add a small load script for tests.

lisa: Product requests clear rollback steps and a short customer-notify template for Dedicated tenants.

akshay: oncall: please add an "approved mitigation" button in alerts (runs vetted command). Filing infra ticket if we agree on the command set.

maria: Suggested detection rules: `sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (model) > 45` OR `kv_miss_ratio > 0.25`. Containment commands to include in playbook: `redwoodctl models patch <m> --set cache.read_only=true` and emergency scale.

kevin: Proposed containment snippets: `redwoodctl models patch model-xyz --set cache.read_only=true` and `redwoodctl capacity scale --pool model-xyz-pool --replicas +2`. Will put PR: https://git.internal/rw/runbooks/pull/2201 (WIP).

sam: I'll add a test scenario that simulates a long-prefix heavy client and confirm KV cardinality growth metrics. Will attach to the PR.

lisa: Product notify template draft: `@product-alerts Subject: KV threshold change for <tenant>. Body: reason, action taken, rollback, contact.` Add one-line customer rollback note.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2310 for mitigation-button work, assigned to infra.

runbook-bot: Created action RB-2201 assigned to kevin, due 1790073600.

maria: Owners & timeline: kevin -> PR by Fri EOD (1790073600), sam -> tests by Tue (1790246400), maria -> staging smoke + merge by Thu (1790429200), akshay -> confirm infra RBAC once INFRA-2310 lands.

kevin: OK, will add a TL;DR box for oncall and a one-click copy area for the alert UI. Ping me if you want to co-own sections.

sam: I'll co-own tests and attach the harness link.

lisa: I'll finalize the product-notify wording and push to the PR.

akshay: I'll watch INFRA-2310 and update RB-2201 with RBAC details.

maria: Thanks. We'll mark RB-2201 in the postmortem action tracker and close when merged + infra ticket created. If anyone needs to swap owners, call it out here.
